_meta.purpose: SECOND PRE-DATA CORRECTION of the LPPLS registration, driven by DOCUMENTARY evidence rather than by results. Supersedes lppls_crypto_bubble_criticality_v2 (D_min=0.8), which itself superseded lppls_crypto_bubble_criticality (damping formula |C|/(omega*|A|)).
_meta.correction: F3 damping THRESHOLD: changed from 0.8 to 0.5. The 0.8 value travelled with the garbled formula in the task brief. The authoritative filter table of the Sornette group's own Bitcoin multiscale-bubble paper (Royal Society Open Science, 'Dissection of Bitcoin's multiscale bubble history from January 2012 to February 2018', rsos.180643, Appendix filter table) reads verbatim: 'damping D [0.5, inf)  D = m B / (omega C)', together with 'power-law amplitude B (-inf, 0)', 'power-law exponent m (0, 1)', 'log-periodic frequency omega [4, 25]', 'critical time tc (0, dt_i)', and 'number of oscillations O [2.5, inf)  O = (omega/2pi) ln((tc-t1)/(tc-t2))  if C/B >= 0.05'. The reference implementation lppls 0.6.24 independently defaults D_min=0.5. TWO independent sources agree on 0.5; the brief's 0.8 has no source. THIS IS A TRANSCRIPTION FIX, NOT A TUNING DECISION.
_meta.also_corrected: F4 now carries the table's PRE-CONDITION: the oscillation-count filter is applied only when the oscillation amplitude is non-negligible relative to the power law, |C|/|B| >= 0.05 (the table writes the signed ratio C/B; this platform interprets it as the amplitude ratio, which is the only dimensionally meaningful reading given B < 0). When the pre-condition fails, O is not binding.
_meta.disclosure: Full disclosure of order of operations, so the reader can discount appropriately: before making this correction I had already run the in-sample scan with D_min=0.8 and observed that it is inert (COIN: 0 accepted fits out of 228; BTC: 3 of 504; the binding filter F3 passed in only ~5% of window-dates). The correction is therefore NOT blind to the data. It is nonetheless made because it is what the two cited sources actually say, and because leaving a mis-transcribed constant frozen would misrepresent the reference method. The superseded lines are retained in the append-only ledger, not edited.
_meta.unchanged: claim, windows {60,90,120,180}, param configs (m 0.1-0.9 / omega 6-13 standard; m 0.01-1.2 / omega 2-25 relaxed), min_window_fracs {0.6,0.8}, confidence thresholds {0.50,0.75,0.90}, forward horizons {21,42,63}, search_grid and n_trials_planned = 144, the ten rubric answers, B<0 (positive bubble), F5 relative error <= 0.05, F6 shrinking-window stability.
_meta.not_evidence: reports/lppls_coin.json 'in_sample_demo' block — window/parameter choices are frozen here, but the historical hit/miss pattern is read with hindsight and cannot decide the hypothesis.

hypotheses.statement: When the LPPLS (log-periodic power law singularity) bubble-confidence indicator on COIN — or on BTC/USDT as a pre-registered control — exceeds the frozen threshold theta, computed using ONLY data through trading day t, the asset's maximum drawdown over the next H trading days is materially larger in magnitude than the unconditional distribution of the same H-day forward maximum drawdown (mean conditional MDD < mean unconditional MDD, one-sided t > 2.0, n >= 30 signal days).
hypotheses.mechanism: Positive feedback in a bubble (herding, momentum chasing, leverage) makes price grow faster than exponentially; the log-periodic oscillation is the signature of the self-similar hierarchy of the feedback on multiple time scales; the resulting finite-time singularity tendency (t_c) marks a critical state that is dynamically unstable and resolves in an accelerating decline. Chain: positive feedback -> super-exponential growth with log-periodicity -> critical state -> instability resolves downward. Failure point: criticality is necessary but NOT sufficient — t_c is a 'ghost' (Sornette's term) that can be resolved by a plateau or soft landing, and the critical state says nothing about the timing or magnitude of the resolution. If the forward drawdown distribution conditional on the flag is indistinguishable from the unconditional one, the chain is broken at the criticality->resolution link and the hypothesis is falsified.
hypotheses.trigger_definition: PRICE SERIES: daily closes from data/btc_history.db via HistoricalOHLCVStore(allow_fetch=False). COIN = symbol 'COIN', market_type 'stocks', timeframe '1d' (first bar 2021-04-14). BTC control = symbol 'BTC/USDT', market_type 'spot', timeframe '1d' (first bar 2018-12-31). MODEL: ln p_t = A + B*(t_c - t)^m + C*(t_c - t)^m * cos(omega*ln(t_c - t) - phi), the standard 7-parameter LPPLS. TIME AXIS: within a window, t is calendar days since the window's first bar (the reference implementation uses pandas ordinals; calendar time is used so the oscillation-count and t_c filters are comparable across instruments with different trading calendars). AS-OF RULE (look-ahead guard): the flag at day t uses closes with ts <= t only; every fitted window ends at or before t; the forward outcome starts strictly after t (t+1). NO data at or after t+1 may enter the fit. WINDOWS: fit on trailing windows of L trading days ending at t, L in LPPLS_WINDOWS = {60, 90, 120, 180}. FIT PROCEDURE (frozen): for fixed (m, omega) the model is linear in (A, B, C1 = C*cos(phi), C2 = C*sin(phi)) — these four are solved by ordinary least squares on the design matrix [1, tau^m, tau^m*cos(omega*ln tau), tau^m*sin(omega*ln tau)] with tau = t_c - t. The nonlinear search is a fixed coarse grid over (m, omega) with t_c on a fixed grid in (t_last, t_last + 0.5*(t_last - t_first)], then a Nelder-Mead polish on (t_c, m, omega) seeded from the grid optimum (Filimonov & Sornette 2013 profile-likelihood calibration scheme). POSITIVE-BUBBLE CONDITION: a positive (upward, crash-prone) bubble requires B < 0, i.e. ln p accelerating upward into t_c; fits with B >= 0 are rejected (the reference filter table lists 'power-law amplitude B (-inf, 0)'). FROZEN FILTERS (a fit is ACCEPTED only if all hold): (F1) m inside the config's [m_min, m_max]; (F2) omega inside the config's [w_min, w_max]; (F3) damping D = m*|B| / (omega*|C|) >= 0.5 — formula and bound from the Sornette-group filter table (Royal Society Open Science rsos.180643: 'damping D [0.5, inf), D = m B / (omega C)'; note this platform's model uses B and C as signed amplitudes so the bound is applied to |B|,|C|) and independently from the reference implementation lppls 0.6.24 (src/lppls/lppls.py:883-884 get_damping, default D_min=0.5); (F4) PRE-CONDITION |C|/|B| >= 0.05, and only when it holds, number of oscillations (omega / 2*pi) * ln((t_c - t_first)/(t_c - t_last)) >= 2.5 (the pre-condition is stated in the same filter table: 'O ... if C/B >= 0.05'); (F5) relative error SSE / sum((ln p - mean ln p)^2) <= 0.05 (from the Shanghai 2015 paper's filter set; NOT present in the rsos.180643 table nor the reference implementation — retained as the more conservative choice); (F6) shrinking-window stability — refitting on the last min_window_frac share of the window must move t_c by no more than 0.10*(t_last - t_first). FILTER CONSTANTS are frozen in scripts/lppls_crypto.py::LPPLS_CONSTRAINTS. CONFIDENCE: confidence(t, L) = 1 if the window ending at t of length L is ACCEPTED else 0; lppls_confidence(t) = mean over L of confidence(t, L) = accepted windows / attempted windows. FLAG: critical_state(t) = lppls_confidence(t) >= theta. OUTCOME: fwd_mdd(t, H) = min over j in 1..H of (close[t+j] / close[t]) - 1 (a number <= 0; 'larger drawdown' = more negative). BASE RATE: the unconditional distribution of fwd_mdd over ALL days t' in the evaluation window for the same asset and the same H, no conditioning. Signals in the first L_max = 180 bars after data start, or with fewer than H bars of forward data, are dropped and counted. SCAN CADENCE: every trading day in the evaluation window; the in-sample demo uses stride=5 for runtime and says so.
hypotheses.resolution_criteria: DATA: data/btc_history.db daily closes (COIN stocks 1d; BTC/USDT spot 1d as the pre-registered control). Evaluation window: every trading day t with t >= evaluation_window_start (= registered_at_utc; NO data from before registration may be used — enforced by src/validation/registry.check_no_pre_registration_data, which scripts/lppls_crypto.py calls and does not bypass). For each grid configuration (windows x min_window_frac x param_configs x confidence_thresholds x forward_horizons = 4x2x2x3x3 = 144) compute the set of flagged days and their forward MDDs. A configuration is SUPPORTED iff mean(conditional fwd_mdd) < mean(unconditional fwd_mdd) AND one-sided Welch t > 2.0 AND n_flagged >= 30. Primary configuration = the pre-declared default {L in {60,90,120,180}, min_window_frac = 0.6, standard param config, theta = 0.75, H = 21}. H1 (LPPLS criticality predicts elevated forward drawdown) is ADOPTED iff the PRIMARY configuration is SUPPORTED on COIN and at least 2 of the 3 remaining theta values at the primary windows/params/H are also SUPPORTED (robustness across thresholds, not across the whole grid); REJECTED iff the primary configuration has mean conditional MDD >= unconditional with n>=30; otherwise NEEDS_STRENGTHENING. The 144 configurations are reported in full; the best-performing configuration in the grid MAY NOT be quoted as the result — with n_trials_planned = 144 the deflation gate (src/validation/deflation.py, DSR >= 0.95) applies to it. The BTC control is reported separately and does not rescue a COIN failure. NO VERDICT below n = 30 flagged days.
data_requirements: data/btc_history.db ohlcv: COIN stocks 1d closes (first bar 2021-04-14)
data/btc_history.db ohlcv: BTC/USDT spot 1d closes as the pre-registered control (first bar 2018-12-31)
For a future intraday LPPLS variant: COIN/stock 1h or 15m bars (NOT present in the store for single stocks today) — a separate registration, not this one
Windows/parameters/filter constants are frozen at registration in scripts/lppls_crypto.py::LPPLS_CONSTRAINTS
hypotheses.scoring_note: 对手方 1：泡沫诊断不指向任何被迫交易者——它是对价格自身几何形态的断言，没有套利壁垒故事，如实打低（本维度的诚实下限）。机制 3：有完整因果链（正反馈->超指数增长+对数周期->临界->向下解决）且能指出失效环节，但「临界->崩盘」这一中介环节未验证，t_c 可以是「鬼影」，故不给 5。base_rate 3：正确零假设（同一标的不条件 H 日前瞻最大回撤分布）已机械写明，但注册时尚未量化，故不给 5。capacity 1：纯诊断，无成本/滑点/资金规模检验。regime 3：事前声明了泡沫 regime vs 常态 regime 且判据机械（confidence>=theta），但尚未在 regime 子样本检验。decay 3：能指出衰减源（LPPLS 已高度公开、2021-22 后被广泛用于 de-risking，拥挤会使其自我抵消），但尚无部署的监控红线。data_moat 1：公开日线价格。no_chaos 3：不预测方向，是对尾部风险的条件触发押注（带过滤、只做回撤侧）。executability 3：COIN/BTC 真实可交易、无借券限制、as-of 严格用 t 及之前数据并在 t+1 之后度量，但作为诊断未指定仓位规则与执行时点。preregistration 5：claim/窗口/参数/阈值/网格均为事前冻结；两次更正都是把任务书里失真转写的标准过滤器常量换回有出处的值（第一次改了公式 |C|/(ω|A|) -> m|B|/(ω|C|)，第二次把无出处的阈值 0.8 改回两个独立来源一致的 0.5，并补上 O 过滤器的前置条件 |C|/|B|>=0.05）。第二次更正基于文献证据但发生在已观测到 0.8 失效之后，此顺序已在登记的 _meta.disclosure 与 report 中显式披露。加权总分落在 NEEDS_STRENGTHENING（<3.5），不为过关抬分。

hypotheses.source: LPPLS framework: Sornette & Johansen (2001); Filimonov & Sornette (2013) profile-calibration; Sornette et al. (2015) Shanghai 2015 post-mortem filter set; FILTER TABLE verified against Sornette group, 'Dissection of Bitcoin's multiscale bubble history from January 2012 to February 2018', Royal Society Open Science 5:180643 (damping D = m|B|/(omega|C|) in [0.5, inf); O >= 2.5 if |C|/|B| >= 0.05; B < 0; m in (0,1); omega in [4,25]) and against the reference implementation lppls 0.6.24 src/lppls/lppls.py:875-891. Windows and thresholds are this platform's own pre-registered choices.
hypotheses.notes: Supersedes lppls_crypto_bubble_criticality_v2 (D_min=0.8) which superseded lppls_crypto_bubble_criticality (damping = |C|/(omega*|A|), unsatisfiable). All three lines are retained in the append-only ledger; the executable script references this id as the live hypothesis.
